subject: Is there a way to size an object to height='100%' inside `shinydashboard::dashboardBody()`?

messages.author: 24de6a9fdc0a14c0
messages.subject: Is there a way to size an object to height='100%' inside `shinydashboard::dashboardBody()`?
parts:
I'd like to embed a leaflet map in the body of a shinydashboard. The default height for leaflet widgets is '400px', but I want it to be sized to the dashboardBody window. So far I have not been able to figure out a way to do this – does anyone have a suggestion? You can see my attempt in the reproducible example below.

Thanks!

## app.R ##
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(leaflet)

# UI: Header ----
header <- dashboardHeader(
        title = "Title"
)
# UI: Siderbar ----
sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(
        sidebarMenu(id="tabs",
                    menuItem("About", tabName = "about", icon = icon("question"),selected=TRUE)
                    
        )
)
# UI: Body ----
body <- dashboardBody(
        fillPage(padding = 10,
                tags$style(type = "text/css",
                           ".third-fill { width: 33%; height: 100%; }",
                           ".two-third-fill { width: 67%; height: 100%; }",
                           "#one { float: left; background-color: #ddddff; }",
                           "#two { float: right; background-color: #ccffcc; }"
                ),
                div(id = "one", class = "third-fill",
                    p("Non-map content will go here")
                ),
                div(id = "two", class = "two-third-fill",
                    p("Map content will go here"),
                    leafletOutput('myMap')
                )
        )
)
# UI: create UI ----
ui <- dashboardPage(header,sidebar,body)

# SERVER: create SERVER ----
server <- function(input, output) { 
        map = leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>% setView(-93.65, 42.0285, zoom = 17)
        output$myMap = renderLeaflet(map)
}

# APP: Execute Shinyapp ----
shinyApp(ui, server)
